## Summary

Describe the problem and the proposed change.

## Evidence

Explain how the change was tested or measured. Link the relevant issue,
preregistration, result, or research-log entry when applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not modify released gold benchmark data.
- [ ] Comparable benchmark arms receive the same models and controls.
- [ ] Source provenance and configured token budgets remain intact.
- [ ] Tests are offline and use committed fixtures or verified local caches.
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .` passes.
- [ ] `uv run pytest` passes.
- [ ] Documentation and result status labels are updated where needed.
- [ ] Every commit includes a Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off.
